criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Inquiries related to account creation, closure, and personal information updates.

categories.name: Transaction Issues
categories.definition: Questions regarding problems with transactions, including failed, pending, or unauthorized transactions.

categories.name: Card Services
categories.definition: Requests for information or assistance related to physical or virtual cards, including ordering, activating, and reactivating cards.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Inquiries about the process and requirements for verifying identity.

categories.name: Refunds
categories.definition: Requests for information or assistance regarding refunds for transactions or purchases.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Questions about fees associated with transactions, card usage, or account services.

categories.name: Transfer Services
categories.definition: Inquiries related to sending or receiving money, including transfer methods and statuses.

categories.name: Technical Issues
categories.definition: Problems related to the functionality of the banking app or services, including login issues and payment failures.

categories.name: Security Concerns
categories.definition: Reports of lost or stolen cards, unauthorized transactions, or account security issues.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions regarding currency exchange rates, fees, and processes.

categories.name: ATM Services
categories.definition: Inquiries related to ATM usage, including locations, issues, and transactions.

categories.name: Contactless Payments
categories.definition: Questions or issues related to the use of contactless payment methods.

categories.name: Top-Up Services
categories.definition: Inquiries about adding funds to accounts, including methods and limits.

categories.name: Product Information
categories.definition: Requests for information about banking products, including cards and services.

categories.name: Customer Feedback
categories.definition: Expressions of dissatisfaction or requests for service improvements.
